notes:
New in 0.1.3.8 - tsunami step 2 (wave programs):
- Space now runs a wave program; W picks the program, Up/Down sets the height of its biggest wave.
- Programs: Single wave; Drawback (the sea pulls back from the beach first, then the crest comes); Wave train (3 waves, the 2nd is the biggest); Level program (4 waves, the 3rd is the biggest).
- The info bar shows the program and when the next wave comes.
- Wave programs come from a level file (levels/beach.json); the sea floor will be added there in 1.4.
- Bug fix: the wave maker kept pumping water in, so the sea rose until it flooded the land (about 75% more water after 25 s, even without a wave). The sea now stays at its level and is much calmer.

From 0.1.3.7: Performance mode for laptops (Esc > Simulation quality).
